leads.name: Sarroch register cluster: Ginepro coccolone, Pino domestico, Eucalipto rosso
leads.species: multiple (Juniperus oxycedrus subsp. macrocarpa, Pinus pinea, Eucalyptus camaldulensis)
leads.why: 2026-08-29 verify pass: passcheck brief flagged a Ginepro coccolone (girth 3.5m, 39.17140,8.95830) and a Pino domestico (girth 5.0m, 39.19996,8.93706) ~16.5-16.9km SW of Cagliari centre, both italy-masaf/sardinia-alberi-monumentali. RAMI (ilregistrodeglialberi.it/italia/sardegna/cagliari/sarroch) confirms Sarroch has 6 registered monumental trees (2x Ginepro coccolone, 3x Pino domestico, 1x Eucalipto rosso), all marked 'Accessibile', but individual RAMI pages checked (IDs 13544, 13546) give different localities ('Canale Bidda Mores - Mareddus'; 'Villa d'Orri', coords 39.112095,9.010225) and different girths (1.79m, 3.45m) than our register candidates, so these do NOT cleanly coordinate-match to the MASAF sheet entries in the brief -- likely different specimens among Sarroch's 6. 'Villa d'Orri' in particular is a historic manor and needs an access check before shipping (could be grounds-restricted despite the 'Accessibile' tag). Not verified to our bar in this pass: no independent source seen beyond the register/RAMI pairing, no confirmed match between the two. A future pass should fetch each of the 6 RAMI ids (13544, 13545, 13546, 13547, 13548, 13549) for exact coordinates, cross-match to the MASAF sheet numbers, and check Villa d'Orri's access status before treating any as a Cagliari day-trip entry. ~20km from Cagliari centre, car required.

leads.name: Other far register candidates, 15-17km from Cagliari centre, unexplored
leads.why: 2026-08-29 verify pass: passcheck brief listed several more italy-masaf/sardinia-alberi-monumentali candidates 15-17km out that this pass did not reach within its ~40 minute window: a Tiglio comune/Tilia x europaea (girth 2.6m, 39.30889-92,9.27944-54, ~15.1km, direction unclear -- not yet located to a named place), a second Eucalitto rostrato/Eucalyptus camaldulensis (girth 5.0m, 39.24777,8.94254, ~15.8km -- distinct from the already-BLOCKED Su Loy/Capoterra eucalyptus at 39.139133,9.012361) and a Pino d'Aleppo (girth 2.6m, 39.38164,9.17315-19, ~16.0km, likely near Sinnai/Foresta dei Sette Fratelli given the latitude, possibly part of the same forest cluster as the verified cag_009 Eucalipto Blu di Campu Omu). Plus 'and 4 more' beyond 16.9km that passcheck's brief did not print in full. None of these were fetched or cross-checked against an independent source this pass; record here rather than guess. A future pass: re-run passcheck.py --brief cagliari with a tighter radius, then work these depth-first, starting with the Sinnai-area ones since cag_009 already established that forest has genuine public access.

leads.name: Pino d'Aleppo, Piazza San Pantaleo / Via San Martino, Dolianova
leads.why: [RESOLVED 2026-08-28, delivered as cag_008] MASAF register sheets 01/D323/CA/20 and 02/D323/CA/20, two pines (girth 340cm and 265cm) flanking the Concattedrale di San Pantaleo in Dolianova, ~18km/23min train from Cagliari. Both confirmed public via the Comune di Dolianova's own 'Bellezza naturale' pages, each stating access is 'libera e fruibile a tutti'. Folded into one entry per the twin/group convention.

blocked.name: Pino di Norfolk (Araucaria heterophylla)
blocked.locality: Vico VII San Giovanni 7, Cagliari (MASAF register sheet 04/B354/CA/20, girth 340 cm, height 38 m)
blocked.reason: BLOCKED, private land. Comune di Cagliari's own designation notice (Jan 2025) states explicitly it stands 'in area privata' in Vico San Giovanni. WebSearch further identifies it as growing in the private garden of the Loi-Congiu house on Vicolo Settimo San Giovanni: a private residence's own grounds. Hard rule 10 does not bend for dwellings regardless of the tree's quality; no evidence found that it is visible from public ground (view-only exception not established). It is a striking tree, nearly 40 m tall and a WWII survivor per local sources (cagliarinverde.com), so worth revisiting if a future pass finds a public vantage point (e.g. visible above a wall from the vico itself) or if the owners ever open it to visitors.

blocked.name: Erythrina falcata (Albero corallo)
blocked.locality: adjacent to Piazza Annunziata, Cagliari (MASAF register sheet 05/B354/CA/20, girth 95 cm, height 16 m)
blocked.reason: BLOCKED, private land. Multiple local sources (L'Unione Sarda, cagliarinews.it, comune.cagliari.it's own Jan 2025 designation notice) describe it as standing in a private area next to Piazza Annunziata, not the square itself. Also comparatively young at only ~40 years per press coverage, so even if access were resolved it is a weaker candidate than the other seven trees on the count-follows-the-trees standard. Worth rechecking if the private grounds are ever confirmed open, or if a public-facing view is documented.

blocked.name: Eucalipto rostrato (Eucalyptus camaldulensis)
blocked.locality: Su Loy, Capoterra (MASAF register sheet 01/B675/CA/20, girth 753 cm, height 25 m, ~13km/26-32min bus from Cagliari centre)
blocked.reason: BLOCKED, private land. Press coverage (vistanet.it, calling it the largest eucalyptus in Italy) describes reaching it via a cypress-lined avenue on private property, where a visitor must ask the custodian's permission to descend to the tree. Hard rule 10 does not bend for a permission-gated private estate regardless of size. Worth revisiting only if the estate ever opens on a fixed public schedule.
